live_gate_reason: RELEASE-001/GEN-003: a real ComfyUI installation was reachable and exercised end to end through the running application itself (not curl alone): one real image generation and one real video generation each reached output_state 'ready' with the produced file correctly indexed into the gallery and rendered inline. The claims below are limited to what was actually exercised; upload, live-websocket, and running-job cancellation remain unverified and are called out explicitly rather than assumed working.

installation._note: GPU model and exact revision/commit are intentionally not recorded (not needed for a compatibility claim and closer to identifying information than a version number); comfyui_revision stays null because /system_stats does not expose a git commit and the git-diagnostic route was not probed. node_packs is the directory-name list derived from object_info's python_module field, not a curated/approved list -- their presence proves nothing about that pack's own behavior beyond the specific node classes actually exercised below.

GET /object_info.note: Used by the app's catalog service; returned 2673 node classes.

POST /prompt.note: Exercised both directly and through the app's own submit path for an image and a video graph.

GET /queue.purpose: reconciliation of running and pending jobs
GET /queue.note: Exercised through the app's GenerationService.reconcile() and directly for the cancellation probe below.

WS /ws?clientId=....note: IMPORTANT: the application never opens this connection at all (grepped; nothing in backend/app calls it). GenerationService.process_event(), which would consume it, is only ever called from tests. All real-world state transitions go through history/queue reconciliation instead (see GEN-003's handoff). This is not a gap this capture closes; it is a confirmed architectural fact worth carrying into the release review.

POST /upload/image.purpose: image and mask upload into the input directory
POST /upload/image.note: Not exercised this session; INPUT-001's own tests are the only coverage.

POST /interrupt.purpose: global interrupt of the RUNNING job
POST /interrupt.note: Not probed. The app correctly never calls it: GenerationService.cancel() only offers running-job cancellation when the upstream client exposes a per-job cancel_job, which ComfyClient does not define, so running cancellation stays disabled by construction, matching the required safe default.

submission_contract.partial_acceptance: Not exercised live this session (no rejected output branch was submitted); still resting on the synthetic history_edge_cases.json fixture and backend/tests/generations coverage.
submission_contract.verified_note: A minimal image graph (CheckpointLoaderSimple -> CLIPTextEncode x2 -> EmptyLatentImage -> KSampler -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage) and a video-shaped graph (same, ending in SaveWEBM with a 2-frame batch) were both submitted and returned the documented accepted-response shape with an empty node_errors.

pending_job.evidence: Three attempts. Two lost the race on this fast CUDA GPU: a job promoted from pending to running (or fully cache-hit and completed) before the delete call landed, and the delete was silently a no-op -- the job still ran to completion. The third attempt, with two heavier jobs queued ahead of the target, succeeded cleanly: the queue listing dropped the deleted prompt_id immediately and GET /history/{that_id} returned {} (empty) afterward, confirming it never ran. This empirically confirms docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's documented risk -- 'a queue read before the call does not make it safe, because the running job can change in between' -- rather than contradicting it.

running_job.note: Not probed; correctly never offered by the app regardless (see the WS/interrupt route notes above).

output_descriptor_contract.images_key: Confirmed live: SaveImage's history entry is {"7": {"images": [{"filename", "subfolder", "type"}]}}.
output_descriptor_contract.video_key: Confirmed live: SaveWEBM's history entry is ALSO under 'images' (not 'videos' or 'gifs'), but carries an additional sibling key 'animated': [true] that no synthetic fixture modeled. GenerationService._apply_history mis-scanned that boolean list as a malformed output and downgraded a fully successful save from 'ready' to 'partial' -- fixed as part of GEN-003 (see history_video.live.json and the updated synthetic history_video.json).
